content: react-leaflet latest is 5.0.0 and requires React 19 as peer dependency (LeafletProvider removed from core). Leaflet core latest stable is 1.9.4; Leaflet 2.0 is alpha with stable targeted later, introduces breaking API changes (constructors replace factory methods, global L removed) - stay on Leaflet 1.9.x / react-leaflet 5.x for production in 2026, avoid Leaflet 2.0 alpha.
